Subject: FintechCorp - Post-call: IR / BCP evidence & SOC 2 status

Hi Alice / David - great to meet today. Quick recap and agreed next steps from our security discovery call: 

1) SOC 2 / compliance status: You said FintechCorp is currently SOC 2 Type II in scope for production services; you're finalizing the 2026 report with your auditor and expect a finalized report in Q4. Please share the latest SOC 2 attestation or controls matrix when available.

2) Vendor security questionnaire: You requested our vendor security questionnaire (v0.9) and indicated you'd like it back within two weeks. Attaching the questionnaire stub and a short evidence checklist we typically provide.

3) Incident response & breach notification timelines: You asked for our incident response (IR) timeline and breach notification policy. Specifically: 
   - How quickly we notify customers for confirmed data breaches (e.g., 72 hours? 30 days?)
   - Our escalation path and sample notification template
   - BCP / DR evidence (RTO/RPO targets, DR test results) for production services

4) Action items / owners: 
   - Jordan (me): provide vendor questionnaire and IR summary, include sample notification wording by end of week.
   - Rachel: pull together BCP/DR evidence (RTO, RPO, latest DR test artifacts) and SOC 2 control mappings with pointers to public docs.
   - Alice / David: confirm list of required evidence and any additional compliance forms from your procurement/security team.

Attachments: redwood-IR-playbook-request.txt (short stub with what we typically provide); requested_evidence_list.xlsx (example checklist).

Next steps: If you can confirm a deadline for the vendor questionnaire response (you mentioned two weeks), we'll prioritise. Also let us know if a PoC/technical review requires a separate security call with our SRE team.

Thanks - Jordan

Jordan Blake

Thanks Jordan - appreciate the clear recap. A couple quick clarifications: 

- SOC 2: Confirming we need the SOC 2 Type II attestation or the controls matrix. Either is fine; the attestation report is ideal but we understand timing. If you can share a controls matrix this week that helps for procurement.
- Vendor questionnaire: Two weeks works. Can you return the completed questionnaire by 11 Aug? If that's tight, let us know.
- IR / breach notification: For FintechCorp we have regulatory requirements to be notified within 72 hours for incidents that affect customer data or cause service interruptions. Our secops address (secops@fintechcorp.com) should get the notification and we will loop legal as needed. Please include: incident detection time, affected services, scope of data, mitigation steps, and ETA for remediation.

I've attached our vendor evidence checklist for reference (we may mark items we require as mandatory).

Next call: Can we do a quick follow-up on Monday 04 Aug to review the initial evidence? If you can circulate the filled questionnaire and the IR summary beforehand that would make that call productive.

Best,
